entities.summary: La Quotidiana is the only Romansh daily newspaper. It is published by the Südostschweiz Mediengruppe and was founded in 1997 with support from the Romansh news agency Agentura da Novitads Rumantscha. The newspaper was temporarily based in Ilanz, afterwards in Chur. It was the first daily Romansh newspaper, and was founded out of a combination of most of the Romansh papers then in existence.
